info.name: CUTAS API (Postgres backend)
info.description: Run folders 0 → 9 in order (Collection Runner), or one request at a time. Import cutas.postman_environment.json and select it first.

item.name: 0 · Public (no token)
item.description: Everything the landing page needs. No login required.

item.name: 1 · Auth
item.description: Registration never accepts role or category. Login returns JWT access (30 min) + refresh (8 h). Login is throttled to 5/min per IP; if you see 429, wait a minute.

exec: pm.test("Role forced to SCHOLAR (role field ignored)", () => pm.expect(j.role).to.eql("SCHOLAR"));

pm.sendRequest({url: pm.variables.get("baseUrl") + "/auth/me/", method: "GET", header: {Authorization: "Bearer " + j.access}}, (e, res) => { if (!e) pm.collectionVariables.set("newId", res.json().id); });

item.name: Update profile (category in body is ignored)

exec: pm.test("Bio saved", () => pm.expect(j.bio).to.eql("Updated bio from Postman"));
pm.test("Accepted image, or clear validation error if no file chosen", () => pm.expect([200,400]).to.include(pm.response.code));

pm.test("Phone / student number not exposed to scholars", () => { j.results.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r).to.not.have.property("phone_number"); pm.expect(r).to.not.have.property("student_number"); }); });
